show.title: Jamai Raja Amar Rahe
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/bV3vy9
show.description: A dying patriarch & devotee of Annapurna Devi, forces Siddhi into a three-year contract marriage with Amar—a quiet cook with a hidden identity as an Immortal Gandharva. He silently protects her—saving her family and securing her success. When Siddhi trusts the wrong man, Amar is forced to reveal his power. Still blind, she demands a divorce. This time, Amar agrees. As the truth unravels, Siddhi realizes too late—she may have pushed away the one man who was holding her entire world together.
